answer_2.quote: For answer generation, we use the token-level F1 score introduced in SQUAD ( . This metric is computed over individual words between the generated answer and the reference message. We denote this metric as Message-F1. Moreover, we leverage advanced evaluation metrics, i.e., BERTScore (BScore) and MoverScore (Mover), for text generation.
